common.offline: You are offline. Existing lessons and practice still work.

home.tagline: Build vocabulary through meaning, sound and speed.
home.foundationReady: Create a focused lesson in any language, then build the connection between meaning, sound and the target word.
home.dashboardBody: Your language-learning lessons are collected here.
home.title: My Lessons
home.emptyBody: Create your first lesson in any language or import an existing Lesson file.

today.title: Today
today.typePrompt: Recall the word before revealing the answer
today.kanaChoicePrompt: Choose the kana glyph that matches the romaji
today.answerDifferent: Compare your answer with the correct one
today.howWell: How quickly did you remember it?
today.ratingHint: Select an answer first. It will not move to the next task.
today.newMaterialBody: Learn {{count}} new Cards with the familiar three-stage flow.
today.completeBody: The next reviews will appear here automatically when they are due.

lesson.librarySaved: The lesson file in the local library is up to date.
lesson.noCards: This lesson has no cards yet.
lesson.deleteConfirm: Delete this lesson? Global cards used elsewhere will be kept.
lesson.resetCardStatisticsConfirm: Reset all accumulated statistics for ‘{{target}}’? Learning progress will not change.
lesson.resetLessonStatisticsConfirm: Reset global statistics for every Card in this Lesson? Shared Cards will also be reset in other Lessons. Learning progress will not change.
lesson.statisticsReset: Statistics were reset. Learning progress was kept.

handwriting.strictHint: Write the symbol approximately from memory. Your handwriting does not need to match the typeface; the check looks for a recognizable overall shape.
handwriting.compare: Compare your writing with the correct symbol
handwriting.autoMismatch: The shape does not look close enough · {{score}}% similarity
handwriting.correctedMatch: You marked the drawing as correct
handwriting.correctedMismatch: You marked the drawing as needing practice
handwriting.notDrawn: The answer was revealed without a drawing
handwriting.systemWrongMatch: System is wrong — I wrote it correctly
handwriting.systemWrongMismatch: System is wrong — I wrote it incorrectly

lessonEditor.description: The complete lesson setup is available here. Edit translations or add forgotten material before saving.
lessonEditor.addItemsHint: Add one new item per line. Existing cards remain unchanged unless you edit them above.
lessonEditor.showImages: Show images already added to cards
lessonEditor.showImagesHelp: This does not search for images automatically. Add an image while editing an individual card.

wizard.title: Create Lesson
wizard.name: Lesson name
wizard.wordsHint: One target word per line. Empty lines are ignored.
wizard.symbolsHint: One symbol or combined sign per line. You will practise writing it by hand.
wizard.duplicates: Remove duplicate target words before continuing.
wizard.existing: {{count}} targets already exist and will reuse their global Cards.
wizard.manualHint: Paste one translation per target line.
wizard.lineMismatch: Expected {{expected}} lines, received {{actual}}. Nothing will be assigned until they match.
wizard.finished: Automatic translations are ready and remain editable.
wizard.unavailable: Offline translation is unavailable for this language pair.
wizard.reviewBody: Complete the active translations and choose an available audio option. Images are optional.
wizard.symbolReviewBody: The symbols are ready for handwriting practice. You can edit individual cards later.
wizard.invalidLanguage: Enter a valid BCP-47 language tag, for example de or en-US.
wizard.languageSearchPlaceholder: Search languages, for example German or ger
wizard.translationTableHint: Edit each translation beside its original word. Use tabs to switch language.
wizard.confirmOverwrite: Every translation is already filled. Replace all values with local automatic translation?
wizard.packageMissingBody: The offline translation package for {{source}} → {{target}} is not installed.
wizard.kanaReadingsReady: Kana Cards were filled with romaji readings. The translation model was not needed.
wizard.timedOut: Translation took too long and was stopped. Check the entered word or fill the value manually.
wizard.failed: Local translation failed. Your manual values were kept.

card.imageHint: Optional. Choose, drop, or paste an image. Large images are reduced to 1024 px.
card.googleImagesHint: The search favors children's picture-dictionary and vocabulary-card illustrations. You can edit the query to request a photo or another style. Google Images opens inside the app. Right-click an image and choose “Use this image”. Check its source and usage rights first.
card.brokenImage: The image could not be processed.
card.imageReady: Image ready. Save the Card to keep it.
card.clipboardNoImage: The clipboard does not contain an image.
card.clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard image access was denied or is unavailable. Try Ctrl+V in the image area or upload a file.

audio.title: Audio
audio.noVoice: No system voice matches this language. The app will never substitute a voice for another language.
audio.fallbackBody: Japanese can use a browser-only Kokoro + Open JTalk voice when no matching system voice exists.
audio.fallbackConsent: The {{size}} MB voice model is installed in this project. Initializing it locally may take time and use about 100 MB of additional memory. Continue?
audio.assetsMissing: Local voice files are missing. Run npm run setup:voices before enabling this voice.
audio.preparationPartial: The lesson was saved, but speech could not be prepared for {{count}} cards. The app will retry when they are played.
audio.offlineReady: Speech is prepared locally and the offline Lesson file is up to date.
audio.providerReady: Application fallback is enabled. New lessons prepare and store Card audio locally.
audio.unavailableForLanguage: No application fallback is available for this language.
audio.microphoneDenied: Microphone access was denied or recording failed.
audio.automaticBody: Audio works automatically for every Lesson. Add a language only to choose a specific voice or install an optional offline voice package.
audio.noCustomLanguages: All languages currently use automatic voice selection.
audio.packageInstalled: The Japanese voice package is installed and ready.
audio.packageDeleted: The Japanese voice package was deleted.
audio.packageDownloadFailed: The voice package could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.

readiness.title: This lesson is not ready for practice
readiness.empty: Add at least one complete Card before starting practice.

learn.title: Learn
learn.question: Question {{number}}
learn.typeJapaneseRomaji: Type the romaji reading or the Japanese word
learn.romajiHint: Romaji is accepted: type ji for じ/ぢ and zu for ず/づ.
learn.completeBody: Every card completed all three stages cleanly.
learn.resumeBody: Your current batch, retries and difficult cards are saved.
learn.leaveConfirm: Leave practice? Your current session is saved.

training.title: Practice builder
training.body: Build a focused practice session from one or more Lessons without changing Learn progress.
training.noLessons: Create or import a Lesson before building a practice session.
training.sameLanguageHint: You can combine any Lessons with the same target language. Shared Cards are included only once.
training.quickSelectionBody: Use any combination of quick selections. The checkboxes below are the final Card list and can still be adjusted manually.
training.plannedExercises: {{words}} words · at least {{exercises}} exercises. Incorrect answers add retry attempts.
training.imagesAlways: Images are always shown with translations when a Card has one.
training.playAudio: Play audio after a correct answer
training.manualSelection: Manual Card selection and Lesson merge
training.manualSelectionBody: Select Cards from several source Lessons. You can practice only them or save them as a normal permanent Lesson.
training.needTwoCards: Choice exercises require at least two suitable Cards.
training.audioFailed: Audio is unavailable for this Card. Choose another exercise format or configure a voice.
training.automaticCollectionsBody: These collections update themselves as you study. They do not duplicate your Cards.

automate.title: Automate
automate.body: Strengthen existing associations without progression or scheduled reviews.

credits.title: Image credits
credits.empty: No attributed images are stored yet.
credits.author: Author

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: General, language, audio and storage preferences.
settings.offlineTranslationBody: Installed packages remain available after restart and are kept even when a language is no longer selected.
settings.translationPackageFailed: The offline translation package operation failed.
settings.maximumNewCardsPerDayBody: The app reduces this automatically when the review queue is heavy.
settings.useImages: Show existing card images by default
settings.portableStorageBody: Application data is stored automatically beside this portable application and moves with the distribution folder.
settings.fallbackStorageBody: The application folder is not writable, so data is using the operating system fallback location shown below.
settings.browserStorageBody: This browser keeps application data in its local site storage. Use full backup to move it to another device.
settings.storageMigrated: Existing application data was copied safely into the portable data directory. The original copy was retained.
settings.portableStorageUnavailable: Portable storage is unavailable at this location. Move the application to a writable folder to keep its data beside it.
settings.temporary: Storage may be cleared automatically by the browser
settings.unsupported: Storage details are not available in this browser
settings.lessonLibraryBody: Choose a project folder once. The app creates a lessons subfolder and automatically updates a self-contained .vtlesson file after Lesson changes.
settings.libraryReady: Automatic Lesson files are enabled in {{name}}/lessons.
settings.libraryPermissionRequired: Allow access to the selected folder to update its Lesson files.
settings.libraryNotSelected: The project folder was not changed.
settings.libraryUnsupported: This browser cannot write directly to a chosen folder. Lessons remain safe in local app storage and manual export is available.
settings.backupBody: Includes lessons, Cards, progress, statistics, media, settings and resumable Learn sessions.
settings.restoreConfirm: Restore this backup? All current local data will be replaced only after the file passes validation.
settings.lessonImportBody: Imports lesson content and media without another user’s progress or statistics, prepares missing speech, and saves an offline-ready Lesson file.
settings.lessonImported: Lesson imported with clean progress and offline speech.
settings.showJapaneseReadingsBody: For Japanese cards with kanji, automatically show a hiragana reading above the word.

errors.unsupportedBackup: This backup was created by a newer, unsupported version.
errors.invalidImport: This archive contains invalid or inconsistent data.
errors.storage: The browser could not save the change. Your existing data was kept.
errors.duplicateCard: A Card with this target already exists for the selected language.
